label: Safer launches and a verified upstream update

sections.title: Safer Local Fork launches
items: The launcher now verifies only the exact app process it started and that process's descendants.
If startup verification fails, cleanup leaves unrelated matching apps untouched.

sections.title: Upstream update reliability
items: The Local Fork now includes upstream 0.57.5 while preserving the local behavior selected during the merge.
Protected-update retries now retain the original merge decisions after verification fixes are applied.

sections.title: Clear task failures
items: Task list, run, and delete failures now stay visible and explain what went wrong instead of silently closing or clearing the Tasks window.

sections.title: Stronger verification coverage
items: Desktop task tests no longer depend on a Node-only runtime contract.
Roadmap completion tests now cover durable direct completion without weakening their checks.
